notes.title: Eagle Flight Version 1.02 Update Released Today!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26621471/afe1d8c304b5c50de7cd6fd1b4f9e26a30effeda.png[/img]

[H1]Version 1.02 Patch - MMR Compatibility & Controller Maps[/H1]

Following the launch of Microsoft Mixed Reality headsets, we have taken some time to update the game to better reflect the different controllers our players use. Please feel free to leave comments if you have any feedback regarding these updates. Should you encounter any problems while playing, please be sure to file a ticket with our Customer Support team at [url=www.support.ubi.com]support.ubi.com[/url] so that we can track the issue and follow up with you!

Please join us in welcoming our new Microsoft MR hatchlings to the skies!

[h1]Changes in this patch:[/h1]
[list][*]Full support for Microsoft Mixed Reality headsets, including Microsoft Motion Controller support.
[*]Full support for Oculus Touch controllers.
[*]Tutorial and all button icons throughout the game have been updated to fully support all motion controllers. Now, players using any of these controllers will know which buttons they need to use in menus, end of match, etc.
[*]Re-centering support for motion controllers - hold RT + LT together for at least two seconds to re-center the view. [i](If players are experiencing the "tilt reminder" message often, it could be because we are detecting you looking too far from "center." Re-centering should remedy this.)[/i]

notes.title: Eagle Flight FAQ (Updated July 13, 2017)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26621471/b0c2baac79f39d1155f30f74dca3eaa19c514a89.png[/img]

[H1]Connection Troubleshooting[/H1]
I am experiencing connection issues when trying to play Eagle Flight online with my PC. How can I troubleshoot these issues?

If you are receiving a connection error or are experiencing lag, disconnections, or other issues related to the online features for the game, please try the troubleshooting suggestions listed on our support site at this address: [url=https://support.ubi.com/en-us/Faqs/000025424/Connection-Troubleshooting-PC-EF]Connection Troubleshooting[/url]

[H1]Save Data Backup and Restore[/H1]
How do I go about backing up and/or restoring my save data for Eagle Flight on PC?

Eagle Flight on Steam uses Steam’s cloud save system, so it is recommended you utilize your Steam client’s back up/restore feature in order to archive/manage your Eagle Flight saves. Please see this [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=8794-yphv-2033]Steam Knowledge Base article[/url] for further details.

[H1]Minimum System Requirements[/H1]
What are the minimum system requirements to run Eagle Flight properly on PC using the Oculus Rift or HTC Vive VR headsets?

In order to run Eagle Flight properly with your Oculus Rift or HTC Vive, your PC MUST meet or exceed these minimum requirements: 

[b]OCULUS RIFT MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: [/b]
Supported OS: Windows 7 SP1 64-bit or newer
Processor: Intel i5-4590 equivalent or greater
Memory: 8GB+ RAM
Video Card: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD R9 290 equivalent or greater
Video Output: Compatible HDMI 1.3 video output
USB Ports: 3x USB 3.0 ports plus 1x USB 2.0 port
Multiplayer:  256 kbps or faster broadband connection
Hard Drive Space: 7.33 GB
Supported Peripherals:
-Oculus CV1
- Xbox One Controller or PC compatible gamepad.
- Note: Oculus Touch is not currently supported.

[b]HTC VIVE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: [/b]
Supported OS: Windows 7 SP1 64-bit or newer
Processor: Intel i5-4590 equivalent or greater
Memory: 8GB+ RAM
Video Card: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD R9 290 equivalent or greater
Video Output: Compatible HDMI 1.3 video output
USB Ports: 3x USB 3.0 ports plus 1x USB 2.0 port
Multiplayer:  256 kbps or faster broadband connection
Hard Drive Space: 7.33 GB
Supported Peripherals:
-Vive headset
- Xbox One Controller or PC compatible gamepad.
- Vive wands are supported.

[b]Supported Video Cards at Time of Release: [/b]
- NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970, GTX 1060 or higher
- AMD Radeon R9 290 or higher
Note: Laptop versions of these cards may work but are NOT officially supported.
 
[b]UPLAY PC:[/b]
This game requires a one-time online activation via the Uplay desktop application for PC. If you do not already have a Uplay account, you will want to create one in the Uplay application or at Uplay.com. After activating your game, it will be tied to your Uplay account and can then be accessed upon logging in via the Uplay desktop application.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Eagle Flight
notes.content:
Eagle Flight is Now Available on Steam!

Developed exclusively for VR Eagle Flight sends you to the skies of Paris to experience the freedom of flying like never before! As an eagle, you soar past iconic landmarks and dive through narrow streets in order to fight opponents and protect your territory.

notes.title: Wot I Think: Eagle Flight
notes.content:
I find myself dreaming of world without humans. Where we have fought our wars, done our damage and in the process been eradicated entirely. No more than we deserve. Eagle Flight [official site], a VR birdflight simulator from Ubisoft, offers an idealised glimpse of that world – where only animals occupy our cities, running and flying free. It called to me today.
… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Ubisoft s First VR Game, Eagle Flight, Is Out
notes.content: Big publishers have been cautious about virtual reality but are starting to dip their toes into the cyberpool now PlayBoxes are floating in it too. Ubisoft have a few VR games coming and this week launched their very first, Eagle Flight [official site]. It’s a fly ’em up set over (and through and under) the verdant ruins of post-humanity Paris, soaring as an eagle in singleplayer explore-o-challenge mode and multiplayer capture the flag. … [visit site to read more]
